instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\dual_pocket_bracket.step. Use iMachining 2D on C:\Users\User\Desktop\dual_pocket_bracket.step to create iRough roughing for both pockets, then add iFinish or Profile finish passes. Pocket floors must be Z=6.000 mm and the outside contour must machine down to Z=0.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for iRough pocket roughing; T2 is a 6 mm end mill for iFinish/profile finishing. Use the SolidCAM CAM-Part, Coordinate System, Stock, Tool Table, operation, simulation/verify, and post-processing dialogs as needed, then save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-7.nc.
